summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a $6 million best efforts public offering of Units and Pre-Funded Units. The offering comprised 898,965 Units at $1.44 per Unit and 3,267,701 Pre-Funded Units at $1.4399 each, with each Unit containing one Class A ordinary share and one Warrant; Warrants are struck at $2.04 and expire six months after issuance. Prime Number Capital acted as sole placement agent for a 5.0% cash fee plus up to $80,000 expense reimbursement. Net proceeds of $4.59 million closed October 9, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown, not a special situation.
